title: A push of a main merge that the silent-undo check flags, with no Drops-lines trailer, is caught before it leaves
why: Lane notes-fix-reverify-large, 11:27 CST Nov 8: builders that merge origin/main into a lane branch push without running lint/check_silent_undo.py; the lane lint then fails on re-wrapped or replaced lines, and each case needs an extra empty commit with a Drops-lines trailer. Incidents: #1597 (docs/decisions/ci-job-caps.md) and #1668 (hooks/guard_frozen.py), both Nov 8. Fix: refuse or warn on such a push, or run the check before push. Check overlap first with #2077 (step lane-lint-before-push), which refuses a push whose commits fail the lane lint's fast checks. Under the owner's 11:27 CST ruling (step habit-is-not-a-guard), a brief line is not a fix.
